subtitle: The books underneath everything: accounts, journal entries, closing months and matching the bank.
typeHint_ASSET: What the business owns: cash, bank, money owed to it.
typeHint_LIABILITY: What it owes: loans, unpaid bills.
typeHint_EQUITY: The owners' share: capital put in, profit kept.
typeHint_REVENUE: Money earned from sales and services.
typeHint_EXPENSE: Money spent to run the business.
name: Name
systemHint: Built-in accounts can be renamed but not hidden, because the app posts to them.
newAccountHint: Pick the kind first. The code is suggested from the free numbers for that kind.
cashFlowHint: Where money through this account shows in the cash flow report.
codeWrong: The code must be 4 to 6 digits.
hideHint: Hidden accounts can't be posted to. Their history stays.
codeFixed: The code and kind can't change once there are entries that depend on them.
noJournalsHint: Every posted transaction makes one, and you can write one by hand for anything else.
reverseBody: A new entry with every debit and credit swapped is posted. The original stays as it is.
reverseThroughTransaction: This entry came from a transaction. Reverse the transaction instead, so the two stay in step.
newEntryHint: Every entry needs debits and credits that add up to the same amount.
entryKindHint_ADJUSTING: For corrections and month-end entries such as depreciation.
entryKindHint_STANDARD: For everyday entries not made by a transaction, such as capital put in.
descriptionPlaceholder: For example: owner put in capital
descriptionNeeded: Write what this entry is for.
linesNeeded: Fill in at least two lines with an account and an amount.
lineBothSides: Line {{number}} has both a debit and a credit. Use one side per line.
lineAmountWrong: The amount on line {{number}} isn't right.
unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal before posting.
statusHint_OPEN: Anyone who records money can post here.
statusHint_SOFT_CLOSED: Only owners and admins can still post. It can be opened again.
statusHint_CLOSED: Final. Nothing can be posted here.
closeBody: Nothing can ever be posted in a closed month. Every earlier month must be closed first.
lockBody: Only owners and admins will be able to post in it. You can open it again later.
lastMonthHint: The last month closes with the year-end close.
closeYearBody: This moves the year's profit or loss into Retained Earnings so next year starts at zero, then closes every month. It can't be undone.
closeYearNeedsLocked: Lock or close every month of the year first.
yearClosed: Year {{year}} closed. {{amount}} moved to Retained Earnings.
yearClosedNoEntry: Year {{year}} closed. There was no profit or loss to move.
howMonthsWorkBody: Lock a month once its figures are checked, so nothing changes by mistake. Close it for good after the accountant is done. The last month of a year closes with the year-end close, which carries the profit forward.
reconcileHint: Check that a bank or wallet account matches its statement, line by line.
startHint: Enter the closing balance from the statement. Then tick the entries that appear on it.
balanceNeeded: Enter the balance shown on the statement.
noReconciliationsHint: Reconciling catches missing, doubled or mistyped entries before they reach a report.
unmatchedHint: Tick each entry that appears on the statement.
nothingUnmatched: Every entry up to the statement date is ticked off.
finishBody: The ticked entries stay matched, and the next statement starts from here.
adjustBody: An entry for the difference is posted to Reconciliation Adjustments (6900), so the books match the statement. Only do this once you're sure nothing is missing.
adjustNeedsApproval: Only owners and admins can book a difference.
statementMatchesApplied_one: {{count}} entry ticked off from imported statements
statementMatchesApplied_other: {{count}} entries ticked off from imported statements
openStatementLines_one: {{count}} imported statement line isn't settled yet, which may explain a difference.
openStatementLines_other: {{count}} imported statement lines aren't settled yet, which may explain a difference.
closedSummary: Finished. {{difference}} was booked as an adjustment.
